pages.name: Three for every two
pages.text: A [[ratio]] compares two amounts. 3 : 2, vans to cars, means three vans for every two cars. Its numbers keep the order of the words.

pages.name: Cars to vans
pages.task: A yard holds these vans and cars. What is the ratio of cars to vans?
pages.why: Cars to vans names the cars first, so it starts with the 2 cars. 2 : 5 means two cars for every five vans. 5 : 2 is vans to cars.

pages.name: Order matters
pages.text: A transformer's [[turns ratio]] is usually written primary first. 10 : 1 means ten primary turns for every one on the secondary. Its voltages keep that ratio, so this one steps the voltage down.

pages.name: Count the turns
pages.task: Count the turns on each coil. What is this transformer's turns ratio?
pages.why: The primary comes first, with 1 turn for every 4 on the secondary, so it is 1 : 4. The turns ratio matches the voltage ratio, so this one steps the voltage up.

pages.name: What fraction?
pages.task: A drink is mixed 1 : 4, squash to water. What fraction of the drink is squash?
pages.why: 1 : 4 compares the squash with the water. The whole drink is 1 + 4 = 5 parts, and 1 of them is squash, so squash is 1/5 of it.

pages.task: A cable run is 2 m and its tail is 40 cm. What is the ratio of the run to the tail?
pages.why: Both lengths need the same units, and 2 m is 200 cm. The run comes first, so it is 200 : 40. With 2 : 40 the tail would be 20 times the run, yet it is shorter.

pages.name: Build the fleet
pages.task: In a fleet, 2 of every 5 vehicles are vans. Drag the line to show the fleet, then pick the ratio of vans to cars.
pages.why: 2 of every 5 are vans, so the other 3 are cars. Vans to cars compares part with part, so it is 2 : 3. The ratio 2 : 5 would compare the vans with the whole fleet.

pages.name: Compression ratio
pages.text: An engine's [[compression ratio]] compares the space in its cylinder with the piston at the bottom to the space with it at the top. 6 : 1 squeezes the gas into one-sixth of the space.

pages.task: Count the blocks of space in each picture. What is this cylinder's compression ratio?
pages.why: Compression ratio is the volume with the piston at the bottom to the volume at the top, 8 blocks to 1, so it is 8 : 1. The 7 counts only the blocks the piston rose through.

pages.name: Put it together
pages.task: Put it together. A lead is 30 cm long and a cable run is 1.5 m. What is the ratio of the lead to the run?
pages.why: Both need the same units, and 1.5 m is 150 cm. The lead comes first, so it is 30 : 150, the shorter length first.
